title: Import complete current stores and preserve prior migration provenance
outcome: The migration importer selects an explicit supported profile and round-trips current stores, including previously migrated stores, without losing durable rows or historical replay bindings.
acceptance: Current-profile full archive imports to an absent destination with exact durable rows, canonical bytes, migration provenance, sequences and operational state preserved; rebuilt FTS is checked logically.
Existing aggregate-root conversion remains validated; profile selection and every table disposition are explicit, with unknown or partially supported profiles refusing before publication.
Populated tests cover current import twice, previous aggregate conversion provenance, pending deliveries and replay, and corruption or existing destination leaves no partial publication.

completion.summary: Current-profile import preserves durable rows and prior provenance; aggregate conversion and exhaustive dispositions remain; populated tests cover current twice, prior provenance, replay, and refuse-before-publication.
